I loved "The Nightingale"! Yes, the ending was emotional, but it was also a perfect conclusion to the story. I think what resonated with me the most was the sisterly bond between Vianne and Isabelle. I also appreciated how the novel didn't shy away from the harsh realities of war, but still managed to convey a sense of hope and resilience. It's a truly unforgettable read.
